xmldoc.short_description: Convert RGB image to grayscale and pass grayscale images through.

param_input_item.param_description: Input numeric grayscale image or m-by-n-by-3 RGB image.

param_output_item.param_description: Grayscale image. Existing grayscale inputs are returned unchanged.

description.p: Convert RGB image to grayscale and pass grayscale images through.
The input must be numeric and non-logical. 3-D inputs must be RGB images with exactly three color planes.

example_item.example_item_description: Convert an RGB image to grayscale
